note: leaves Quebec with Inspector Wilcox and eight other ranks
entrance to Pond Inlet; pack ice prevents entering to Salmon River
Staff-Sergeant Joy comes over the ice and reports to Wilcox aboard
sails from Pond Inlet for Ellesmere
enters Jones Sound; Fram Fiord blocked with ice, two attempts to enter fail
a fairly suitable place found opposite Smith Island and named Craig Harbour; stores landed
Wilcox and six men left ashore; farewell in a blinding snowstorm
back at Pond Inlet, again hampered by ice
leaves on the return voyage, having reconnoitred Dundas Harbour
